 ONE OR EIGHT to Bring ‘Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8-’ to Manila This October
 By  media  |  October 21, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Subscribe Google Whatsapp Pinterest Digg Reddit Stumbleupon Vk Weibo Pocket Tumblr Mail Meneame Odnoklassniki 
 1DERZ, are you ready to go all out with ONE OR EIGHT? 
 Japanese boy group ONE OR EIGHT is bringing its Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8- to Manila on October 23. This marks the group’s first-ever performance in the Philippines!
 The eight-member act will take the stage at Samsung Hall, SM Aura Premier. It is part of a three-city Southeast Asian showcase tour, which will also make stops in Singapore and Bangkok.
 Comprising MIZUKI, NEO, REIA, RYOTA, SOUMA, TAKERU, TSUBASA, and YUGA, ONE OR EIGHT debuted in August 2024 with the single “Don’t Tell Nobody.” Their name draws inspiration from the Japanese expression ichi ka bachi ka , meaning “all or nothing,”. It reflects their fearless approach to pursuing their dreams under the motto “BET ON YOURSELF.”
 The group has been building momentum on the global stage with tracks like “TOKYO DRIFT.” The song sampled Teriyaki Boyz’s iconic “Tokyo Drift (Fast & Furious)” and gained significant traction on TikTok. They have also expanded their reach through “KAWASAKI,” including collaborations with American rapper Big Sean and Filipino artist Felip of SB19, alongside remixes featuring thủy and pH-1.
 Fresh off the release of their debut EP EN-GÏNE on September 16, ONE OR EIGHT is entering a new chapter in its musical journey. The title combines “EN,” representing the connections between people, and “GENE,” symbolizing the creation of new possibilities. The project reflects the members’ determination to forge their own paths while moving forward together with their fans.
 With their first Philippine performance just around the corner, Filipino 1DERZ can look forward to experiencing ONE OR EIGHT’s dynamic stage presence and music live for the first time.
 ONE OR EIGHT Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8-: Manila
 Date: October 23, 2026 (Friday)
 Venue: Samsung Hall, SM Aura Premier, Taguig City
 Doors Open: 7:00 PM
 Show Starts: 8:00 PM
 Ticket Information
 Tickets are available through Ticketmaster Philippines .
 VVIP Standing: ₱4,500
 VIP Standing: ₱3,500
 General Admission Standing: ₱2,500
 Ticket prices exclude booking fees. 
 ONE OR EIGHT’s Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8- will bring the group’s all-or-nothing spirit to 1DERZ this October. Don’t miss the chance to welcome the eight-member group to Manila for their first-ever Philippine performance!
 Reported by Danah Elyssa Garcia
